en: The image shows a picturesque hilltop fortress or castle, accessed by a funicular railway that climbs steeply up a wooded hill. On top of the hill is a baroque-style chapel with a distinct onion dome, stone fortifications, and several historic-looking buildings. The postcard contains handwritten text along the top and upper left, and printed text in red at the top left that reads: 'Graz Schlossbergbahn.'
